display_long_description:
Homestay by Mixeal offers an immersive virtual experience where you can explore a stunningly detailed environment. This experience is a testament to ArchViz and 3D Visualization capability that Mixeal offers to its clients. Immerse yourself in high-quality visuals with fun hand-tracking interactions that makes you feel right at home.

Whether you're walking through the cozy interiors or interacting with objects, the experience is seamless and engaging. 

🎁 **EXCLUSIVE OFFER:** Discover an exclusive promo for Final Overs, Mixeal’s VR cricket game, right within the app!


[media]

Seamless **hand tracking** for immersive experience

[media]

Walkthroughs made easy with seamless **spectator web app**

[media]

Smooth **locomotion** using your fingers

[media]

Just **clap** and change floor material and wall color

[media]

Experience near-to-life **object interaction**

[media]

Roam around environment with **realistic quality**

[media]

**Download now** and interact with the coziest space, enjoy an innovative blend of home design and virtual reality, all from the comfort of your own VR headset!
